data.body: Final disposition: implemented and merged as Gerrit change 2823. RCA: the false Verified -1 path was the single-attempt Gerrit patchset checkout in the Verified route; when Gerrit/autodeploy contention caused a transient fetch 5xx/RPC failure, CI had not evaluated patchset code but the route still failed. Following the operator ruling, I did not use Verified-0 or CI concurrency groups and did not touch Terraform; instead every Gerrit patchset checkout in gerrit-verify and its reusable Verified-lane workflows now retries in-job (15s, then 45s). RED: tests/unit/test_gerrit_checkout_retry.py failed on the old one-attempt workflow shape. Validation: targeted workflow tests passed; lint/typecheck/module-size/complexity/mechanism ratchets passed; full make verify passed with GIT_CONFIG_* unset; Gerrit 2823 passed LLM-Review+1 and Verified+1 and was submitted. Closed as env_integration.
